name: cdc-chair-stand-oblique
description: RTMPose-t keypoints from a 12.8 s cut of the CDC STEADI '30-Second Chair Stand Test' video (public domain, PD-USGov-HHS-CDC), oblique shot, sampled at 12 Hz. Three stands and three sit-downs. Coordinates and scores only: no pixels from the video are in this file.

room.room: CDC STEADI chair-stand set (oblique shot, hand setup)
room.notes: Hand setup, oblique CDC shot: level camera assumed at 0.81 m, focal 1035 px, standing clinician assumed 1.65 m. Approximate.

calibration.note: Hand setup for the CDC oblique shot. Camera height 0.81 m worked out by taking the standing clinician as 1.65 m; focal length 1035 px from a partial calibration of the front shot; level camera assumed. Not measured.

truth.method: event times read from the keypoints, not from Preempt's states: the frame the mean knee angle first passes 150 degrees (knees straight) and first drops back below 130 degrees (knees bent)
